events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: Legendary rapper Tupac Shakur died in Las Vegas after a shooting on this day in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur, who left us on this day in 1996. His music continues to resonate.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: The iconic guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away in London on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Hendrix's Influence
angles.copy: Remembering the legend Jimi Hendrix, who left us on this day in 1970. His groundbreaking guitar work changed music forever.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: On this day in 1969, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in music history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and songwriting with The Pretenders remain as powerful as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis track?

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his seminal album 'Imagine' on this day in 1971.

angles.name: A Message of Peace
angles.copy: On this day in 1971, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity is just as relevant today.

events.title: First iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple launched the original iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Tech Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? On this day in 2001, Apple changed how we listen to music forever. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your all-time favourite 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy icon John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us some of the greatest comedy ever.

events.title: The White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Experimental Beatles
angles.copy: On this day in 1968, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece – what's your favourite track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: The iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: A True Showman
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day in 1991. His unparalleled stage presence and voice live on forever.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Beatles Evolution
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', marking a significant evolution in their sound. A true classic!

events.title: John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: The world mourned the death of John Lennon on this day in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: On this day in 1980, we lost John Lennon. His vision for peace and his incredible music continue to echo around the world.
